project_title: Retail Demand Forecasting & Dynamic Pricing Optimization

model_provenance.benchmark_note: Notebook benchmark metrics are from the validation-selected test evaluation; the saved demo artifact is packaged for interactive inference and has been sanity-checked separately.

pricing_provenance.elasticity_method: Controlled log-log regression with meal and center fixed effects plus promotion indicators

demo_artifact_note: The interactive artifact uses the finalized 205 boosting rounds and the same 13-feature schema as the notebook. The notebook-reported metrics are the primary benchmark; artifact QA metrics are a separate sanity check and are not presented as the notebook evaluation.
